text: This study reports the final survival outcomes of the MIMic phase I trial, evaluating the safety and efficacy of combining oral FMT with healthy donor stool and anti-PD1 immunotherapy as first-line treatment for advanced melanoma. The trial enrolled 20 patients who received a single dose of FMT followed by nivolumab or pembrolizumab. The primary endpoint was safety, while secondary endpoints included objective response rate (ORR), progression-free survival (PFS), and overall survival (OS).
